facts.claim: 作者把 knock-knock 归为「最持久却最烂」的格式，说它原本围绕有人在门口的情境，并用 Shaun 一条演示名字要被转成「忘带钥匙」的句子。
facts.quote: One of the most enduring joke formats, despite being absolutely rubbish, knock-knock jokes were originally based around the idea of someone being at a door

facts.claim: 作者判定 knock-knock 最好的一条其实是对形式的颠覆，并以此反推这类笑话整体质量之低。
facts.quote: It says a lot about the low quality of most knock-knock jokes that the best one out there is a subversion of the form

facts.claim: 作者把 shaggy dog stories 定义为很长、结尾极平淡或干脆没有结尾的笑话。
facts.quote: Shaggy dog stories are long, long jokes, usually with incredibly anticlimactic punchlines or a total lack of them.

facts.claim: 作者交代 Mark Twain 据说是拥趸，但「shaggy dog」这个名字到 1930 年代才因一条多毛猎犬的长笑话出现，punchline 是「It’s not that shaggy」。
facts.quote: Mark Twain was said to be a fan, although the shaggy dog name only came about in the 1930s, with a popular long joke about a hairy hound with the punchline, ‘It’s not that shaggy.’

facts.claim: 作者说明这类故事不靠逐字背诵，而是给讲者一个松散框架，可以塞跑题、旁白、不必要的细节和文学典故。
facts.quote: They’re not meant to be recited word for word – they exist as loose frames for the teller to do what they want with.

facts.claim: 作者把 walks-into-a-bar 解释成极高效的 setup：一进门的人与店里工作的人互不相识，却被情境绑定必须对话。
facts.quote: You immediately have two characters who don’t know one another – the person that’s just walked in and the person that works there – and are bound by the situation to have a dialogue.

facts.claim: 作者用「马走进酒吧」那条点明：最受喜爱的酒吧笑话其实可以发生在任何地方，只是放在酒吧更好笑。
facts.quote: could take place anywhere, but is just funnier in a bar.

facts.claim: 作者指出「鸡为什么过马路」作为笑话讲不通，却照样成了世界最著名的笑话。
facts.quote: doesn’t really make sense as a joke, which somehow hasn’t stopped it becoming arguably the best-known joke in the world

relations.pair: Shaun 一条 / knock-knock 的悬念机制
relations.relation: 幽默（如果有）全押在悬念上：读者等着看一个普通名字怎么被扭成一句关于进门的陈述。
relations.quote: The humour, such that there is any, lies in the suspense – how is this normal-sounding name going to be transformed into a statement about getting through a door?

relations.relation: 作者拿这唯一一条作为「颠覆形式」的样本，说明正统 knock-knock 已经烂到只能靠打破自己取胜。
relations.quote: the best one out there is a subversion of the form

relations.pair: 马的酒吧笑话 / 酒吧这个场景
relations.relation: 笑话与酒吧并无必然关系，地点只是让它更好笑的加成，说明该格式的核心是 setup 效率而非酒。
relations.quote: could take place anywhere, but is just funnier in a bar.

relations.pair: 鸡过马路 / 学界的两种解读
relations.relation: 作者把「刻意平淡」与「涉及鸡之死的宗教寓言」并置，显示这条笑话的效果取决于解释而非文本。
relations.quote: are divided, in fact, as to whether it’s deliberately anticlimactic or some sort of confusing religious allegory involving the chicken dying.

numbers.meaning: 「shaggy dog」这一名称出现的年代，晚于马克·吐温被传为粉丝的时间。
numbers.quote: although the shaggy dog name only came about in the 1930s

numbers.meaning: 酒吧 setup 提供的角色数量：互不相识的顾客与店员。
numbers.quote: You immediately have two characters who don’t know one another
